channel.title: Moonbrim Bedtime Stories
channel.description: Gentle, cinematic bedtime stories for little dreamers — the audio companion to the Moonbrim video series. New episodes as each story premieres on YouTube.
channel.itunes:author: Moonbrim

item.title: Poppy and the New Egg 🦆 — a poppy kids story for big sisters
item.description:
Looking for bedtime stories to read to 5 year olds? Poppy had mama all to herself until an egg rolled toward the reeds on a stormy night — she chased it, warmed it through the dark, and at sunrise a new friend looked up. A cozy, cinematic short for little siblings.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Whale Who Sang Too Deep 🐳 A Whale Bedtime Story for Kids
item.description:
Meet Wren, a small humpback calf with a white star on her tail whose song rolled too deep until a dark canyon needed exactly that sound. A gentle whale bedtime story for kids with sunlit surface ribbons, a quiet calf, and a lullaby that carries the pod to sleep.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Elephant Who Was Afraid of Small Things 🐘 Elephant Bedtime Story for Kids
item.description:
Meet Juno, a round baby elephant who can carry logs but jumps at beetles; when a cricket sings beneath her feet she later discovers a hidden spring that saves the herd. This gentle bedtime story about elephant moments brings soft savanna sounds and cozy visuals for little ones.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Sock Who Lost His Twin 🧦 — a kids story about socks
item.description:
Blue, a small sky-blue striped sock, searches the washer and the lost-and-found box for his missing twin and finds a new, mismatched friend instead. This gentle kids story about socks follows a tiny adventure through the laundry room and the warm corners of a family home.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Thunder Who Was Shy ⛈️ A Kids Story About Thunder — Calming Bedtime Tale
item.description:
Boom is a small indigo thundercloud whose hello makes every window slam shut, but when the river rose only his thunder could wake the sleeping valley. This calming bedtime tale is a kids story about thunderstorm with cinematic cloud characters and a gentle dawn ending.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Little Root Who Saved the Garden 🌱 A Bedtime Story for Kids
item.description:
Root is a tiny pale-gold root who grew in the dark while her twin drank the morning. On a burning July day she dug past a great rock and touched hidden water — a bedtime story for kids in English that’s perfect for winding down tonight.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Moth Who Was Afraid of the Dark 🦋 A Gentle Bedtime Tale — kids moth stories
item.description:
Plume was born at noon and clung to the light until the night she got lost between the lamps, waiting for the last iron lantern to gutter. Watch her wings drink the moonlight above the sleeping hills — one of the sweetest kids moth stories for little ones who sleep with a nightlight.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Snail Who Lit the Lighthouse 🐌 Bedtime Story About Snails on a Stormy Night
item.description:
When the great light died, Pearl the slowest snail began inching up the storm-swept lighthouse wall. In this gentle bedtime story about snails, Pearl's hidden glistening trail becomes a silver spiral that guides three small boats safely home.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: Do preschoolers need a backpack? The Backpack Who Was Scared of School 🎒
item.description:
The night before her first day, Mila finds her new red backpack trembling under the bed, its two brass-button eyes lit by a slender beam of moonlight. A gentle bedtime tale for little dreamers — and a cozy answer for parents wondering "do preschoolers need a backpack" as they pack love and courage together.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Little Cloud Who Couldn't Rain ☁️ — a bedtime story about clouds for kids
item.description:
The little cloud lives above a sun-parched valley and stretches herself thin to shade a single sunflower, until her tiny tears become a night of rain. This gentle kids story about clouds uses warm, painterly skies to calm little dreamers and the grown-ups reading with them.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories
